Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue of 364-378, probably Arles mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right.[--]ALEN[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath; R / A in left field, ?star in right field. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: CO[NS]. Diameter: 17.6mm,…
